title: JasonTheWeen gets thrashed by Ryan Garcia after claiming he could "beat the f*ck out of" him
summary_full: Ryan Garcia and Twitch streamer JasonTheWeen finally settled their online trash talk inside a boxing ring. After claiming he could "beat the f*ck out of" the WBC welterweight champion, Jason stepped into a sparring session that turned heavily one-sided. The session ended early after his corner threw in the towel, before Garcia later shared advice and praised him for getting inside the ring.
